script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Venus, your ruling planet, is forming a tense square to Mars in your 7th House of Partnerships, while Saturn trines your 9th House. This earth-sign tension pulls your fixed Taurus energy between desire and duty. Mercury sits in your 6th House, sharpening every word you speak at work. In love, that Mars square will flare old jealousy — if taken, do not test your partner today; if single, a Venusian encounter near water could turn serious after sunset. For money and career, Saturn's trine to your 9th House blesses your 10th House reputation, so a senior may finally approve your long-delayed proposal. Avoid signing a Venus-ruled contract after 3 PM, but expect an unexpected blessing: a former client returns with payment. Follow for tomorrow's reading before this transit shifts again.
